flag_rule: Status validated is measured, unless the method is reconstructed, interpolated, estimated or forced, or the qualification is estimated, which is estimated; raw, corrected and pre-validated are provisional. Doubtful values keep their class and are counted in notes.
notes: Flow at Paris-Austerlitz is computed from the water level through a rating curve kept by the regional hydrometry service; Hub'Eau labels these values method 'Calculée' (computed) (Hub'Eau, HydroPortail).

Hub'Eau publishes a daily mean flow (QmnJ). Before 1966 the level was read by an observer about once a day (more often in floods), so the early 'daily mean' often rests on one reading (Hub'Eau station history, as in the level series).
Flow is in liters per second as published (100,000 L/s is 100 m³/s); not converted (Hub'Eau).

The same station codes as the level series are used through 2005, each only inside its window, with no offset. From 2006 on, Hub'Eau publishes Paris flow mainly under the Austerlitz flow station F700000103, so the series uses it from January 1, 2006 (Hub'Eau).
On 1366 days from 2006 on that both F700000102 and F700000103 publish a flow, F700000102 differs from F700000103 by a median +1.9% (5th to 95th percentile -4.3% to +5.1%) (Hub'Eau).
Days published by more than one chain station: 2121 (2006-02-18 to 2026-10-19); on those days the station whose window holds the date wins, as in the level series (Hub'Eau).

Days qualified 'Douteuse' (doubtful) by Hub'Eau: 25267, by decade {'1900s': 2864, '1910s': 2193, '1920s': 2677, '1930s': 2788, '1940s': 3070, '1950s': 3029, '1960s': 3007, '1970s': 3008, '1980s': 2631}. They are kept and keep their status class, because the publisher validated them; the flag says the value may be off, not that it was estimated (Hub'Eau).
Paris flow is influenced by four large reservoir lakes upstream, which Hub'Eau says reduce flood peaks, so recent flows differ from natural flows (Hub'Eau).
Rows in window: 46169. Empty values dropped: 0. Negative values dropped: 0 (Hub'Eau).
